name: Editorial Evidence
promise: A practice thesis, one signature artifact, and the work that proves it, before anything else.
description: The platform's default composition, set as a long-form issue. It opens with the practice thesis at display size over the issue's contents, the signature work on its plate with the standfirst beside it, and a byline, then up to five chapters whose section heads hang in a margin column beside a 1 px spine, with evidence, captions, and fact sheets in the notes column beside what they support. Every section renders in its own markup, the archive sits behind a disclosure, each case study gets its own page, and a colophon closes it. It runs no motion beyond state feedback, and its color, type, and materials come from the appearance packs.

sources.source: The v1 Editorial composition's single reading column and section labels
